required_files.ja_headline: ぼかしが、ウインドウについてくる。
required_files.scene: The shipping onboarding screen with its window-following illustration and primary tagline.
assertions: Use the current shipping onboarding screen.
Keep the full illustration and product tagline legible.
The illustration describes proportional geometry, not semantic tracking of text or fields.

required_files.ja_headline: 画面、窓、文字。3つの選び方。
required_files.scene: The current shipping Home or feature screen showing Display Pin, Window Pin, and Text Follow (Beta) as three separate creation modes.
assertions: Recapture this scene after Text Follow (Beta) ships; the prior two-mode onboarding image is obsolete and must not be reused.
Use the current product terminology.
Keep Display Pin, Window Pin, and Text Follow (Beta) visually distinct.
Keep the localized Beta badge next to Text Follow visible and legible; do not label BlurFollow, Window Pin, or the release itself as beta.
If match modes are visible, show Exact, Prefix, Contains, and Regular Expression; do not reuse three-mode copy.
Do not imply that Text Follow (Beta) and Window Pin are the same feature.

required_files.ja_headline: 共有前に、すべてのマスクを確認。
required_files.scene: The shipping onboarding screen that tells the user how to inspect each sharing method before presenting.
assertions: Keep full-display, single-window, and browser-tab instructions legible.
Show that the user checks the preview; do not imply automatic certification.
Do not present a technical status as a content verdict.
Show that Share Preview composes matching Window Pins and completed Text Follow (Beta) results for its selected source.
Do not present a completed zero-match scan as proof that OCR found everything; with strict safety on it must be covered.

required_files.ja_headline: 共有方式に合わせて選ぶ。
required_files.scene: The shipping Share Guide with full-display, single-window, and browser-tab guidance visible.
assertions: State that another app's overlay is normally excluded from single-window and browser-tab capture.
Point single-window users to Share Preview for Window Pins and completed Text Follow (Beta) matches.
State that any relevant Text Follow (Beta) rule which is unconnected, scanning, failed, unavailable, or inconsistent clears the old preview and selects a full cover.
State that Text Follow (Beta) OCR and Share Preview both exclude child windows.

required_files.scene: The current shipping Settings screen showing local data controls, capture permissions, and support links, with version and license information where visible. Select a capture region without pricing or commerce promotions.
assertions: Recapture the current shipping Settings UI; the prior Settings capture is a reference only and contains obsolete pricing promotions.
Keep free allowances, discounts, prices, and one-time purchase or unlock claims out of both captions and visible captured UI.
If the strict-safety control is visible, show its current state and do not imply that turning it off preserves the same leak resistance.
Keep the support, local-data, permission, and version sections legible.
Do not imply that local processing controls what a meeting app does after sharing.

global_requirements: Capture the shipping UI and icon from the same build submitted to review.
The existing pre-Text-Follow raw and final screenshots are references only: recapture and regenerate every scene from the current shipping build before submission.

Every scene or caption that names or depicts the OCR feature must visibly use Text Follow (Beta) in English or Text Follow（ベータ） in Japanese; the Beta label must not apply to the app or distribution as a whole.
At least one current scene must visibly demonstrate Text Follow (Beta) results composed inside Share Preview; old copy claiming Window-Pin-only composition is invalid.
Use no real customer name, email, token, internal URL, or meeting participant.
Keep macOS menu-bar details and notifications free of personal data.
Use each locale's headline; do not place both languages in one image.
Use legible text, sufficient contrast, and safe margins at every accepted size.
Do not use absolute claims such as guaranteed, leak-proof, secure, or always hidden.
Do not include competitor names, ratings, unavailable features, or an App Store badge.

Follow App Review Guideline 2.3.7: no pricing or free-service claims, including free allowances, discounts, or one-time purchase or unlock promotions, in screenshot captions or visible captured UI. Check every image in every submitted locale.
